# Josupeit.Practices.Jobs.Abstractions

> Interface-only NuGet package defining the observable job model: `IJob` (identity, `IsPending`/`IsExecuting`/`IsCompleted`/`IsCompletedSuccessfully`/`IsFaulted`/`IsCanceled`, `Exception`, a `Changed` event, `Start()`, `Cancel()`), its covariant typed variants `IJobWithResult<TResult>`, `IJobWithProgress<TProgress>`, and `IJobWithProgressAndResult<TProgress, TResult>`, and `IJobFactory` with eight `Create` overloads over asynchronous delegates. Ships the awaiting support itself: `await job` and `job.Wait()` complete when the job completes and never throw; call `job.ThrowIfFaulted()` to rethrow. Targets netstandard2.0 and net8.0, has no dependencies, and lives in the `Josupeit.Practices.Jobs` namespace.

Install with `dotnet add package Josupeit.Practices.Jobs.Abstractions`. All types live in the `Josupeit.Practices.Jobs` namespace - not `Josupeit.Practices.Jobs.Abstractions`. Types:

- `IJob` - `event EventHandler Changed`, `Guid Id`, `Exception? Exception`, `IsPending`, `IsExecuting`, `IsCompleted`, `IsCompletedSuccessfully`, `IsFaulted`, `IsCanceled`, `Start()`, `Cancel()`
- `IJobWithResult<out TResult>`, `IJobWithProgress<out TProgress>`, `IJobWithProgressAndResult<out TProgress, out TResult>` - `IJob` plus `TResult? Result` and/or `TProgress? Progress`; covariant
- `IHasResult`/`IHasResult<out TResult>`, `IHasProgress`/`IHasProgress<out TProgress>` - the value interfaces, with `object?` non-generic parents
- `IJobFactory` - eight `Create` overloads: `Func<Task>`, `Func<CancellationToken, Task>`, `Func<IProgress<TProgress>, Task>`, `Func<IProgress<TProgress>, CancellationToken, Task>`, and the four `Task<TResult>` counterparts; asynchronous delegates only, progress before token
- `AwaitableExtensions` (`GetAwaiter()`, `ConfigureAwait(bool)`, `Wait()`), `IJobAwaiter`, `ConfiguredJobAwaitable`, `RethrowExtensions.ThrowIfFaulted()`

`Create` does not start the job; `Start()` does. `Changed` fires on every state transition and progress report and is what awaiting is built on. `await job` never throws and is `void` - read `Result` afterwards and call `ThrowIfFaulted()` to rethrow. An untyped single-parameter lambda binds to the `CancellationToken` overload, not the progress one. `TResult?` is `int` for `int`, not `int?`. Base classes live in `Josupeit.Practices.Jobs.Core`; factories in `Josupeit.Practices.Jobs.TaskPool` and `Josupeit.Practices.Jobs.Scheduler`.

- [Josupeit.Practices.Jobs.TaskPool](https://codeberg.org/DerPeit/Josupeit.Practices/raw/branch/main/src/Josupeit.Practices.Jobs.TaskPool/llms-full.txt): `TaskPoolJobFactory`, jobs on the thread pool.
- [Josupeit.Practices.Jobs.Scheduler](https://codeberg.org/DerPeit/Josupeit.Practices/raw/branch/main/src/Josupeit.Practices.Jobs.Scheduler/llms-full.txt): `SchedulerJobFactory`, jobs routed through an `IScheduler`.
- [Josupeit.Practices.Schedulers.Abstractions](https://codeberg.org/DerPeit/Josupeit.Practices/raw/branch/main/src/Josupeit.Practices.Schedulers.Abstractions/llms-full.txt): `IScheduler`, the awaited-call model for work nobody needs to watch.
